mapper.sql: select id, field_type, field_id, field_name, category_id, data_type, unit, mode, description, cast(value_type_config as varchar) as value_type_config, metadata_config, search_keywords, use_count, recommend_priority, status, tenant_id, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from iot_standard_metadata_field
mapper.select: select f.id, f.field_type, f.field_id, f.field_name, f.category_id, f.data_type, f.unit, f.mode, f.description, cast(f.value_type_config as varchar) as value_type_config, f.metadata_config, f.search_keywords, f.use_count, f.status, f.tenant_id, f.create_by, f.create_time, f.update_by, f.update_time, c.category_name from iot_standard_metadata_field f left join iot_standard_category c on f.category_id = c.id where f.id = #{id} and f.tenant_id = #{tenantId}

select f.id, f.field_type, f.field_id, f.field_name, f.category_id, f.data_type, f.unit, f.mode, f.description, cast(f.value_type_config as varchar) as value_type_config, f.metadata_config, f.search_keywords, f.use_count, f.status, f.tenant_id, f.create_by, f.create_time, f.update_by, f.update_time, c.category_name from iot_standard_metadata_field f left join iot_standard_category c on f.category_id = c.id where f.field_id = #{fieldId} and f.tenant_id = #{tenantId}
where field_type = #{fieldType} and field_id = #{fieldId} and tenant_id = #{tenantId}

where status = 1 and field_type = #{fieldType} and tenant_id = #{tenantId} and (field_id like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or field_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or search_keywords like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or description like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%')) order by use_count desc, id desc
